usage: lean_evidence.py verify [-h] --statement-fidelity STATEMENT_FIDELITY
                               [--artifact-dir ARTIFACT_DIR] [--claim CLAIM]
                               [--project-root PROJECT_ROOT]
                               [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--lean-bin LEAN_BIN]
                               [--lake-bin LAKE_BIN] [--lake | --no-lake]
                               source

positional arguments:
  source

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --statement-fidelity STATEMENT_FIDELITY
  --artifact-dir ARTIFACT_DIR
  --claim CLAIM         record the outcome as mechanical evidence about this
                        claim in research/MATH_STATE.json. This is the only
                        way mechanical evidence is ever written: the tier is
                        chosen by the code that read the compiler's answer,
                        never passed in
  --project-root PROJECT_ROOT
                        the project whose state --claim writes to, and the
                        root artifact paths are recorded against
  --timeout TIMEOUT     explicit compile timeout; omitted waits for Lean to
                        finish
  --lean-bin LEAN_BIN
  --lake-bin LAKE_BIN
  --lake, --no-lake     compile through `lake env lean`. Omit to decide from
                        the host: lake when a Lake workspace applies to the
                        source, bare lean otherwise. Pass --no-lake to force
                        bare lean even where a workspace exists

usage: math_state.py revise-claim [-h] [--project-root PROJECT_ROOT] --id ID
                                  [--statement STATEMENT]
                                  [--formal-file FORMAL_FILE]
                                  [--formal FORMAL] [--use-current-context]
                                  [--retire ID=WHY]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project-root PROJECT_ROOT
  --id ID
  --statement STATEMENT
  --formal-file FORMAL_FILE
  --formal FORMAL
  --use-current-context
                        restate this claim against the newest version of its
                        context
  --retire ID=WHY       stop standing on an assumption, with the reason the
                        proof does not need it

usage: math_state.py judge [-h] [--project-root PROJECT_ROOT] --claim CLAIM
                           [--assumption ASSUMPTION]
                           --verdict {supports,refutes,inconclusive} --by BY
                           [--artifact ARTIFACT]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project-root PROJECT_ROOT
  --claim CLAIM
  --assumption ASSUMPTION
                        judge this assumption of the claim instead
  --verdict {supports,refutes,inconclusive}
  --by BY               who answered; the independence key
  --artifact ARTIFACT   what the opinion was reached from: the certificate
                        that was read, or a file holding the reasoning. Citing
                        the certificate is what makes the verdict stop
                        counting if the reading it approved is later replaced

usage: subagent submit [-h] --task-id TASK_ID [--description DESCRIPTION]
                       --command COMMAND [--mode {direct,supervised}]
                       [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                       [--monitor-interval MONITOR_INTERVAL] [--model MODEL]
                       [--run-dir RUN_DIR] [--cwd CWD]
                       [--override-discussion REASON] [--clear-stop]
                       [--no-preflight] [--cpu-count CPU_COUNT |
                       --cpu-ids CPU_IDS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --task-id TASK_ID     Unique task identifier
  --description DESCRIPTION
  --command COMMAND     Shell command to run
  --mode {direct,supervised}
                        direct: just run (no LLM). supervised: run + periodic
                        LLM monitoring
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Max seconds (default: 2h)
  --monitor-interval MONITOR_INTERVAL
                        Base seconds between supervisor checks; backs off
                        while healthy, tightens when degrading (supervised
                        mode)
  --model MODEL         Supervisor model (defaults to configured
                        supervisor/shared model)
  --run-dir RUN_DIR     Run directory whose progress.jsonl/status.json the
                        supervisor reads and where it writes STOP on early-
                        stop
  --cwd CWD
  --override-discussion REASON
                        Break-glass: launch even though a supervisor is parked
                        on an open discussion. Records REASON to the
                        experiment ledger.
  --clear-stop          Remove a leftover run_dir/STOP before launching
                        (otherwise submit refuses a poisoned run dir).
  --no-preflight        Skip the supervised-mode pre-launch RL config
                        preflight (escape hatch for a known-good config).
  --cpu-count CPU_COUNT
                        Lease this many distinct CPUs before creating task/run
                        artifacts; the launched process inherits the selected
                        affinity.
  --cpu-ids CPU_IDS     Lease exact comma-separated CPU ids before launch;
                        conflicts with other participating live subagents are
                        rejected.

usage: subagent wait [-h] --task-id TASK_ID [--timeout TIMEOUT]

options:
